A block marker on a continuation line of multiline alt text is escaped

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<img alt=\"Alpha\n-\nBeta\" src=\"image.png\">", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
